description: Asked the question she had held since four o'clock, and was answered.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Gave the verdict, stopped at the end, and refused a second time.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Asked whether the houses were friends, and stayed with the house.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Waited, answered the boy question, and left the notch alone.
name: William Shakespeare
